summary: Fractional-depth failures fixed (11 → 0); full gate blocked by out-of-scope positional harness lookups.
body:
Changed [resolve.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixdepth/crates/interchange/src/scene/resolve.rs:365) and [sr_core_corpus.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixdepth/crates/interchange/tests/sr_core_corpus.rs:609). No commits; locks released.

The cause was `finish_paint` parsing every `z` as an integer. The fix consults the existing XSD type table: geometric `xs:double` values must be finite and contribute zero to sibling stacking; integer stacking retains its existing bounds. Original depth text remains intact for overlay serialization.

Public API unchanged: `pub fn resolve(doc: &SceneDoc<'_>, limits: &ResolveLimits) -> Result<Resolved>`. Added private helper: `fn stacking_z(element: &str, value: &str) -> Result<i64>`.

The XSD’s `nodeCoreAttributes/z` defines integer stacking; `cameraType`, `object3DType`, `particles3DType`, `oceanType`, and `blackHoleType` declare geometric doubles. These accept no length suffixes. A `threeD="true"` shape still has integer stacking. Checked against `sr-model/build.rs::builtin_rust`, `sr-model/src/parse.rs`, and `sr-eval/src/program.rs`. No scene-render code was copied.

No export change was needed: overlay serialization preserves attribute text, while sequence export references the overlay as media. Tests verify exact camera `z` and object `z`/`depth` retention, plus preservation of that reference through export/re-import.

TDD results:

- `scene_corpus_fractional_depth`: ignored red run failed with `"-0.5" is not an integer`; enabled test now passes.
- `scene_geometric_depth_is_not_a_stacking_index`: red failed on `554.256`; green passed.
- `scene_fractional_depth_keeps_sibling_paint_order`: red failed on `554.256`; green passed.
- `scene_fractional_depth_survives_overlay_export_and_reimport`: red failed on `-554.2560000000001`; green passed.
- `scene_depth_types_reject_hostile_values`: passed before and after, retaining integer bounds and rejection of non-finite values and length suffixes.

Pinned corpus comparison, 1,343 cases:

| Failure category | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| fractional-depth | 11 | 0 |
| material-override | 6 | 6 |
| external-expression | 122 | 122 |
| geodesic-camera | 18 | 18 |
| voxel-palette | 14 | 14 |
| linked-audio | 18 | 18 |
| generated-id | 12 | 12 |

Failing cases: **201 → 190**; failure records: **255 → 244**. No new failure records. Successful import modes and oracle-validated exports: **1,676 → 1,698**; successful re-imports: **3,352 → 3,396**. All other failure records are unchanged.

VM results: formatting and clippy passed; Wasm passed for **51 crates**. Complete crate testing with `--no-fail-fast`: **317 passed, 1 failed, 7 ignored**. Logs: [gate](/tmp/fixdepth-gate.log), [complete tests](/tmp/fixdepth-tests-complete.log), [corpus](/tmp/fixdepth-after.log).

The sole gate failure is `scene_corpus_known_failures_never_hide_panics`: removing our known-regression entry shifts `KNOWN_REGRESSIONS[1]`. Both positional lookups at [line 634](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixdepth/crates/interchange/tests/sr_core_corpus.rs:634) and [line 697](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixdepth/crates/interchange/tests/sr_core_corpus.rs:697) should select `material-override` by name. Your explicit test-file scope excludes those edits; the requested permission remains pending, so the required full gate is not green.
